entities.summary: Garlin Gilchrist II is an American politician and engineer serving as the 64th lieutenant governor of Michigan since 2019. A member of the Democratic Party, formerly a candidate for the Democratic nomination in the 2026 Michigan gubernatorial election, he is running for Secretary of State.
